$description: ComboChart (platform/charts/ComboChart.jsx, library wave 9, lane B): its component tokens. Columns, lines and points are the frame's marks (chart-*); these place the two legends and size the points. No new color.

combo-chart-legend-gap.$description: Combo chart: the space between the columns' legend and the lines' legend in one row.

combo-chart-legend-row-gap.$description: Combo chart: the space between the two legends when they wrap to two lines.

combo-chart-point-radius.$description: Combo chart: the radius of a line's point (an 8px point with the frame's ring).
